name: ROG Deck
author: fredde
description: Control panel for ASUS ROG laptops: power modes, temperatures and fans, keyboard lighting with auto-off, AniMe Matrix, FN-lock, battery limit, Battery saver, a CPU power limit for Silent, display and GPU mode, from the Omarchy bar. Updates itself from the panel.

barWidget.description: The power mode icon in the bar (scroll to switch), plus the stats you pick: temperatures, fans, power, GPU, battery and refresh rate. Click for the full ROG control panel.
